student_book.learning_goal: Recognise and write A/a and B/b; say the initial sounds in familiar words.
vocabulary: A a — ant, apple; B b — bag, bat.
language_focus_content: A is for ant. B is for bag.
practise_items: 1. Point to A, a, B, b and say each letter name.
2. Circle the picture/word beginning with /b/: bag, ant.
3. Trace A a and B b three times.
student_book.use_english: Say: A, ant. B, bag.
student_book.self_check: Self-check: I can do this:  □ Yes   □ Not yet
